errors.text_span: около и малко над 0,55–0,60 по скалата
errors.evidence: The phrasing used to describe the values for Romania and Cyprus is confusing. The values for Romania and Cyprus are approximately 0.55 and 0.59, respectively. The phrase "около и малко над 0,55–0,60" (around and a little over 0.55–0.60) is poorly constructed, particularly the "малко над" (a little over) part in conjunction with the upper end of the range, as no value exceeds 0.60.
